aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

landing.does.capacityBody: State how much you can make at a time and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers cannot choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and the card terminal you already take payment on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, stable wifi and the same opening hours every week. You are in a new place every week, at different times, with patchy or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab is built for exactly that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering is automatically paused, so customers cannot place orders you don’t see. Keep taking orders with the app for iPhone, iPad and Android.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already use on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, pitches and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your posts on Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers pre-order and choose a collection time. Shorter queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: »Where are you parked tonight?« »What desserts do you have?« Your WhatsApp gets answered while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill, based on your own menu and your own schedule. Messenger and Instagram are coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: »Where are you parked tonight?« »What desserts do you have?« Soon your WhatsApp will be answered while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
landing.final.lede: Upload a picture or a screenshot of your menu, and we’ll turn it into an ordering page that works, which you can try out in under 60 seconds. Your dishes, your prices. No signup, no payment card, nothing to install. Have a look, and then decide.
